business_summary: WG Tech (JiangXi) Group Co., Ltd. engages in the provision of glass-based circuit boards and related electronic devices in China. The company's products include mini and micro-LED glass substrates, semiconductor advanced packaging substrates, CPO applications and RF devices, MIP carrier and direct display substrates, UTG ultra-thin flexible glasses, CPI transparent polyimides, and touch products. It also engages in FPD optoelectronic glass finishing activities, such as glass thinning, coating, cutting, and photolithography. WG Tech (JiangXi) Group Co., Ltd. was formerly known as WG Tech (JiangXi) Co. Ltd. and changed its name to WG Tech (JiangXi) Group Co., Ltd. in August 2024. WG Tech (JiangXi) Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 2009 and is based in Xinyu, China.
